why: One table of times as a person writes them, run by test_times.py against every reader of one (review 2026-11-05 runs A-08). ps: what the grammar gives in ps (null: no time); except: a reader that reads it otherwise, by its own documented convention (readers).

readers.common: tools/common.py parse_time(text): a plain number in model units (1), as viewedit.parse_t and testmarks read a view; any unit of UNIT_PS (zs, as too)
readers.wavemcp: tools/wavemcp.py ps_of(text): parse_time(text, 1000), a plain number in ns
readers.vcd2wavedrom: tools/vcd2wavedrom.py to_ps(text): parse_time(text, None), a unit needed, no negative time
readers.parseT: wavelens/src/model.js parseT: a plain number in model units, fs … s
readers.links: vscode/links.js linksOf('@ ' + text), one link the whole line: a time of a log, a unit needed, no sign, digits before the point
readers.cocotb: python/wavelens_cocotb.py bound_ps(text): a unit needed (a number is ps but no text), no negative, '3 cycles' none (the page counts them); float() reads the number
readers.cli: sva/cli/src/main.rs time() through sva diff --from: a plain number in ps, no negative, a + sign taken; whole ps (rounded)
